name: Imatinib 400 mg (Chronic Myeloid Leukemia - Chronic Phase)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Chronic Myeloid Leukemia v1.2026

supportiveCare: Take with a large glass of water and food to minimize GI irritation
monitoring: CBC with differential every 2-4 weeks initially until CHR
Quantitative RT-PCR for BCR::ABL1 on International Scale (IS) at 3, 6, 12 months (milestone: <=10% at 3m, <=1% at 6m, <=0.1% MMR at 12m)

drugs.name: Imatinib
drugs.notes: Imatinib 400 mg PO once daily continuously with a meal and water. May escalate to 600-800 mg daily for accelerated phase or inadequate molecular response.
